camera.name: CAM_Main
camera.note_fov: AUTO sensor fit maps the 36 mm sensor to the LONGER (1620 px, vertical) side: three.js PerspectiveCamera.fov (vertical) = fov_vertical_deg for the 2:3 poster. For a landscape browser window keep the same focal length idea, i.e. horizontal fov ~= fov_vertical_deg, or keep fov_vertical_deg and accept a wider view.

color.compositor_grade: scenes/final: Hue Correct lifting warm/yellow saturation, global saturation 1.04, lift (0.99,1,1.01) gain (1.035,1,0.965); S-curve in view curve mapping

light_shaft.note: a narrow hard volumetric beam from the upper left, in FRONT of the school (scenes/final/compose.py SHAFT block).  three.js: an additive cone/billboard along this line reads closer than a SpotLight (no volumetrics).

volume.note: Principled Volume: scattering = density*Color, absorption = density*(1-Color) (absorption colour black) -> extinction = density for every channel: transmittance T(d) = exp(-density * d); the teal comes from the in-scatter.

fog_three.FogExp2_note: FogExp2 is 1-exp(-(k d)^2); k chosen to match the exact curve at its 50 % distance.  It is thinner before d50 and thicker after.

volume_box.note: finite cube (build_env: a World volume absorbs the sun)

world.note: background = mix(bottom, top, smoothstep(from_min, from_max, view_dir.z_blender)) * strength; view_dir.z_blender = view_dir.y_three

caustics.loop: 4D voronoi with the 4th dimension on a circle, T = fract((frame-1)/240)
caustics.note: emission added on up-facing sand/rock (albedo x pattern x light); fade with camera distance 8 -> 30 m.  Not baked into any web texture.

marine_snow.motion: per speck: life fract(T*cycles+phase) cycles 1|2, drop 0.15-0.5 m, sway amp 0.01-0.06 m at integer frequencies; fades at the wrap

snapshot.note: Exact evaluated FishSwarm output at frame 1 (scene.blend).  species_index = index into species.json "species" order; variant = library variant k (phase k/6); swarm_index = index into composition.swarms.  length_m is the RENDERED body length: it already includes the wrap fade (fade < 1 = a fish shrinking in/out at a lane end; fade is informational, do not multiply again).  The quaternion rotates the GLB-local fish frame (head +X, dorsal +Y).

fg_path.formula: P(f) = A + (B-A) * fract(phase + n*(f-1)/240)  (linear, wraps B->A)
P(f) = A + (B-A) * fract(phase + n*(f-1)/240)  (linear, wraps B->A)
P(f) = A + (B-A) * fract(phase + n*(f-1)/240)  (linear, wraps B->A)
P(f) = A + (B-A) * fract(phase + n*(f-1)/240)  (linear, wraps B->A)

look.note: values = compose.py LOOKS[preset] (scene half), env = build_env.LOOK_PRESETS[preset] over CFG (env half).  Grade order (compose setup_grade): Hue Correct (hue curve with hue_rot in the cyan band; saturation curve with warm points x warm_sat) -> saturation x sat -> Lift/Gamma/Gain -> top-edge multiply (x top at the top row, 1 at 60 % height, smoothstep) -> bloom (scene-linear threshold) ; then view: curve -> exposure -> Khronos PBR Neutral.

shafts.profile: emission = strength * (bell(r/rc) + 0.22 bell(r/(2.6 rc))) * axial * streak, bell(q) = max(0,1-q^2)^3; axial = smoothstep fade-in over the top 45 %, fade-out over the bottom 60 %; streak = noise(local xyz * (28,28,0.9)) mapped 0.3..0.7 -> 0.7..1.2 (compose _shaft_material)

bubbles.motion: T = fract((frame-1)/240); t = fract(T*b_cyc + b_phase); rise: +t*b_rise (up); sway: a = 2pi(T*b_k + b_ph2), s = b_amp*(0.4+0.8t), offset blender (sin(a)*s, cos(a)*s*0.6) -> three (sin(a)*s, -, -cos(a)*s*0.6); radius = b_size * min(8t, 6.5(1-t), 1) * (0.8+0.4t)
bubbles.shading: rim emission = rim_emission * b_glow * facing^2 (layer weight 0.35), colour rim_color; centre ~95 % transparent + a sharp glossy glint (compose _bubble_material)

fog_measured.note: Fish-free plate, frame 1, right half of the frame, median per row.  Rows below about elevation -3 deg see sand, not water.  linear_rgb is scene-referred radiance BEFORE the exposure: three.js fog/background colour in linear space with renderer.toneMapping = NeutralToneMapping (= Khronos PBR Neutral) and toneMappingExposure = 2^exposure_ev reproduces display_srgb_255 (minus the compositor grade).

scene_props.env_keepout: KEEPOUT_* empties: vertical cylinder, base centre = empty location, extends +Z by prop height, prop radius (m) includes prop margin

coordinate_conversion.rotations: fish / placed objects: R_three = C R_blender C^T; camera & lights: C R_blender (their local look-down -Z / up +Y frames already agree)
coordinate_conversion.handedness: C is a proper rotation (det +1): right-handed stays right-handed
coordinate_conversion.swarm_frames: domain_size = (length along e1, width along e2, height along e3) is frame-relative: e1 = direction, e2 = up x e1, e3 = e1 x e2 with up = +Z (blender) = +Y (three)

sand.uv: world_blender_xy / tile_m  (three: u = x/tile, v = -z/tile, then glTF flips v; just use the exported uvs with RepeatWrapping)

macro_patchiness.note: multiply the tile albedo by mapRange(noise(world_xy*0.18), from_range -> to_range) / baked_as to restore the 5 m patches

relief.flat_uv: TEXCOORD_1.v; the glTF exporter flips v, so three reads uv1.y = 1 - flat (env.js)
